csv_scope_of_work: The City of Anniston, Alabama is seeking statements of qualifications fromexperiencedairport planning and engineering consultants to perform services for the next five yearsat the Anniston Regional Airport. Possible work will include preparation of preapplications and applications for federal and state funding, airport layout plan, capital improvement plan, Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) plan, runway extensionjustification, environmental studies, feasibility studies, benefit cost analysis, airport compliance issues and analysis, engineering design and planning for runways and taxiways, runway/taxiway/apron/access road construction and rehabilitation, pavement maintenance, airport lighting, NAVAIDS, weather reporting system, land acquisition, fencing, roads, fueling facilities, terminal/hangar area improvements, airport terminal buildings, hangars, airport surveys including topographic survey, boundary survey, obstruction survey/analysis, and the FAA AGIS process and procedures.

title: Airport Planning & Engineering Services
short_description: RFQ for five-year airport planning and engineering services at Anniston Regional Airport.
project_scope: Five-year on-call airport planning and engineering services for Anniston Regional Airport, potentially including airport layout plan, capital improvement plan, DBE plan, runway extension justification, environmental and feasibility studies, benefit-cost analysis, compliance analysis, design and planning for runways and taxiways, runway/taxiway/apron/access road construction and rehabilitation, pavement maintenance, airport lighting, NAVAIDS, weather reporting systems, land acquisition, fencing, roads, fueling facilities, terminal and hangar area improvements, terminal buildings, hangars, surveys, obstruction analysis, and FAA AGIS procedures.
services: Airport planning and engineering consulting services; funding applications; studies and analyses; civil/airside design; rehabilitation planning; survey services; terminal and hangar improvement planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an airport planning and general engineering on-call contract, not focused on bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, or sports facilities.
- Includes terminal buildings and hangars, but only as possible minor components within a broad airport services framework.
- Strong emphasis on planning studies, compliance, funding applications, surveys, and airfield infrastructure.
- No clearly defined structurally ambitious building or bridge scope.
- Framework-style multi-year services contract with very broad disciplines reduces strategic fit for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The procurement is for five-year on-call planning and engineering services covering a wide range of possible airport projects, including runways, taxiways, terminal buildings, hangars, roads, lighting, and other improvements. Because no specific project package, quantities, or capital program values are provided, a realistic total construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee or estimated contract value is stated. The notice is a qualifications-based, five-year airport planning and engineering services procurement with undefined task orders, so a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Statements of qualifications are requested from experienced airport planning and engineering consultants. Specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
